# simpleaudit-docs

Documentation for simpleaudit-docs

> https://github.com/SushantGautam/simpleaudit

## Guides

- [Quickstart](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/guides/quickstart/): Run your first local LLM safety audit using the CLI or Python API.
- [Installation](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/guides/installation/): Install SimpleAudit and configure local model environments.
- [Architecture](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/guides/architecture/): Understand the audit pipeline, judge registry, and scenario structure.
- [Key Ideas](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/guides/key-ideas/): Learn how adversarial probing and safety metrics are defined.
